prompt: Decide whether a class used from a given package actually needs an import, and explain why not. Complete ImportNecessityChecker and run the tests.
explanation: Java gives you three kinds of type for free: types in your own package, types in java.lang, and types with no package at all. Everything else needs an import, so the check reduces to comparing the package part of the name against those cases. The subtle one is java.lang.reflect: it only looks automatic -- the rule is an exact package match, not a prefix match, which is why equals("java.lang") is right and startsWith would be wrong.
hints: Split the name at its last dot: everything before it is the package that owns the class.
Compare the owning package with equals -- startsWith("java.lang") would wrongly cover java.lang.reflect.
Write reason first and let needsImport just compare its result with "NEEDED" so the two can never disagree.
